principle: Author knowledge is not automatically character knowledge.

global_mystery.name: The Thing We Don't Talk About
global_mystery.character_facing_rule: Characters do not properly remember it and instinctively avoid discussing it.
global_mystery.author_truth: It connects to the Botanists, hyperspace, biological displacement and formation of the gang.
global_mystery.reveal_policy: Keep it recurring and do not over-explain. Reveal author-level truth gradually.

rules: Never give a character the complete origin chronology merely because it exists in the author-level timeline.
Nigel knows he was once a lugworm but does not remember the transition.
Nigel does not consciously understand why he wants to go to the seaside.
Contradictory character memories may coexist as character-level truth; do not silently resolve them into authorial fact.
Record when a character learns a fact in an approved scene before updating their knowledge state.
Unexplained areas remain unexplained until explicitly developed.
unresolved: Why these particular entities were caught up in the event.
The identity of the discorporeal entities.
Why transformations produced these forms and personalities.
Why Nigel retained his lugworm sensibilities.
Why Rufus is convinced he is a dog.
What exactly happened during the heavy festival night.
The precise nature of the Thing We Don't Talk About from the characters' perspective.
